premises.text: Traditional cattle weighing is labor-intensive, costly, rarely done, and stressful/injury-prone, causing weight loss
premises.evidence_span: obtaining weight information is labor-intensive, time-consuming, and expensive, so it's rarely obtained

premises.text: Portable 3D-camera software estimates cattle weight automatically as animals pass, ~10x faster and stress-free, with a dashboard recommending sell/feed/health/genetics actions
premises.evidence_span: Our proprietary software uses a portable 3D camera to estimate the weight of the cattle

premises.text: Unlike still-photo apps for small farms or expensive fixed passage scales, the portable camera works for all farm sizes at about R$3,000 hardware and R$1 per animal-month
premises.evidence_span: Olho do Dono is portable. The 3D camera costs around R$ 3,000 and we charge R$ 1 per animal month

premises.text: Platform also recommends products that optimize weight gain and earns a commission on those sales
premises.evidence_span: Our platform also gives recommendations on products that can optimize weight gain and we make a commission fee on that
